slug: 2025-04-03 Now is the time to invest in locally-owned health data systems

facts.fact: The HISP Centre (DHIS2's developer) states that Ethiopia's Ministry of Health has scaled its DHIS2-based health information system nationwide, with more timely and more complete data; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: nationwide; facility-level reporting mentioned, tiers not named
